quizName: Hardest Questions in Washington Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, what should you do?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.

questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long trips, take a rest break at least every two hours to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: Where should you get information about your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Your owner's manual is the best source for information about your motorcycle. It has details about how it works, how to operate it, and what maintenance it needs.

questions.question: What is true about clothing when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It should be loose so it flaps in the wind.
It does not need to cover your arms or legs.
You should not wear a jacket in warm weather.
It can protect you if you crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can protect you if you crash.
questions.explanation: The right clothing protects you in a crash. Always wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely, even in warm weather. Your clothing should fit snugly so it does not flap but loose enough so you can move easily.

questions.question: Which item is not protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Safe riders wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves.

questions.question: What should motorcycle riding clothing cover?

options.text: Your arms completely, but not your legs.
Your legs completely, but not your arms.
Whatever is most comfortable, even if it is not safe.

questions.explanation: Wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely for proper protection.

questions.question: How should you check your tire pressure?

options.text: Compare it to another tire's height.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check your tire pressure before every ride. A tire that looks fine may actually be under-inflated, so you cannot rely on your eyes alone.

questions.question: What certification should your helmet have for maximum protection?
questions.explanation: Buy a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards for the best protection.

questions.question: When should you use a turn signal?

options.text: When you plan to speed up.
Only when there is heavy traffic.

questions.explanation: Use your turn signal every time you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is watching.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces are slippery for tires. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, and metal covers are all more hazardous than dry pavement.

questions.question: What is a danger of riding next to parked cars?

options.text: You may not find a parking spot.
A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
Other drivers may drive slowly while looking for parking.
The road surface may be uneven.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may suddenly pull out into your path.
questions.explanation: Parked cars create dangers. A driver might pull out without looking. A car door could open into your lane. A pedestrian might step out from between cars.

questions.question: Motorcycle riders should choose footwear with soles that:
questions.explanation: Wear riding boots or shoes that are tall and sturdy to cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT need to be checked regularly?
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, controls, chains, sprockets, shock absorbers, fasteners, and brakes. Even small mechanical problems on a motorcycle can be very dangerous.

questions.question: Mirror checks:

options.text: Should only be done on long trips.
Should be part of your regular scanning routine.
Are not helpful because you cannot change what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be part of your regular scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your normal routine. Also check mirrors before changing lanes, when stopping at intersections, and before slowing down.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?

options.text: A baseball cap that fits snugly

questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap that fits snugly
questions.explanation: To protect yourself, wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and pants, high sturdy boots or shoes that support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: Riding gloves are often:
questions.explanation: Motorcycle riding gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: If a friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Tell them to take less-crowded roads.
Get other friends to talk them out of riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get other friends to talk them out of riding.
questions.explanation: Never allow someone to ride if they have been drinking. Do whatever you can to stop them. Get a group of friends to step in and apply peer pressure.

questions.question: Your lane position should:

options.text: Hide your intentions from other drivers.
Encourage other drivers to share your lane.
Help you see others and be seen.
Keep you close to road signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Help you see others and be seen.
questions.explanation: A good lane position helps you see others and be seen by them. It helps you avoid wind blasts, blind spots, and surface hazards. It discourages other drivers from sharing your lane and gives you an escape route if danger appears.

questions.question: Since most crashes happen during daylight, you should:

options.text: Wear bright clothing all the time.
Ride on the shoulder to stay out of traffic.
Wear dark clothing all the time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright clothing all the time.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Always wear bright clothes when riding to be more visible, even in daylight.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the most protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the best protection when riding.

questions.question: The most important thing you can do to survive a crash is to:

options.text: Wear a high-quality helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a high-quality helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a high-quality helmet that is fastened securely is the best thing you can do to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: To get the best protection, wear a helmet that:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly around your head and have no visible damage.

questions.question: ____ can remove alcohol and its effects from your body.
questions.explanation: Only time can reduce your blood alcohol level. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot lower your blood alcohol or make you sober. They may help you stay awake, but they do not change how much alcohol is in your body.

questions.question: When it is obvious that you are going to turn, you:

options.text: Do not need to use a turn signal.
Should still use a turn signal.
Only need to use a turn signal if there are nearby pedestrians.
Only need to use a turn signal if you are at a stop light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should still use a turn signal.
questions.explanation: Always use your turn signal every time you turn or change lanes. Use it even if you think your turn is obvious. Other drivers may not see you. There could be vehicles nearby that you don't notice.

questions.question: Head and neck injuries can be reduced by:
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet greatly reduces the risk of head and neck injuries. A helmet is your best protection in a crash.

questions.question: Which types of brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have one brake for each wheel. The front brake is stronger and does most of the braking work.
